props.note: Tall black-smoker chimney standing in for the Beebe 1-5 vent complex (403-410 degC supercritical fluid, Connelly et al. 2012). `material_hint: "sulfide"` for the near-black, rust-streaked palette. No photogrammetric model of the real chimneys was found, so shape and exact height are a reconstruction; the mound's location and the field's record temperature are sourced. Rendered as a sulfide mound with the tall chimney, its neighbours, animated smoke and Rimicaris-style shrimp swarms on the walls (variant shrimp); the cluster layout is a game reconstruction.
Second, shorter black-smoker chimney in the Beebe 1-5 mound cluster, same rationale as beebe-chimney-1.

Chimney on the western sulfide mound (bvf-sulfide-mound-west POI), representing one of the seven mounds mapped by Webber et al. (2015). Reconstruction: general mound location and count are sourced, this specific chimney's shape is not.
